newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERRILL LYNCH STARTS HUHTAMAKI AS REDUCE.
newsitem.headline: MERRILL LYNCH STARTS HUHTAMAKI AS REDUCE.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Merrill Lynch initiated coverage of Finnish confectionery and packaging group Huhtamaki Oy with a "reduce" recommendation, Merrill said in a report dated April 25 and received on Friday.

"We feel that the current valuation more than adequately reflects the refocussed corporate strategy, and in the short term may possibly underestimate the risks arising from increased seasonability," Merrill Lynch said.
"In addition, our 1998 forecasts are around 10 percent below consensus," Merrill Lynch said.

"In the intermediate term, we believe that earnings surprises are likely to be negative. The main cause of this is increased seasonality ... following the radical restructuring seen last year," it said.
"None of our favoured valuation methods ... can support a share price higher than the one we have today," it said, referring to an April 25 share price of 233.50 markka.
At 1610, Huhtamaki's I share traded 3.50 markka lower at 222.00.
Merril Lynch said its long-term recommendation on the share was neutral.
